'''Marlon Fenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. Following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]] Empress [[Vaylin]] and the formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]], he joined Doctor [[Alirra Semhess]]' group of rogue Republic scientists who worked on a secret project on the [[X7-Cratus]] space station. Eternal Alliance operatives under [[Theron Shan]] eventually discovered Semhess and her project and a strike team was dispatched to X7-Cratus to stop [[RS-33]] adrenal from becoming a galactic threat. Alliance forces engaged and defeated Marlon Fenn, but during their fight the station's containment systems were damaged and [[RAK-5 serum]] started leaking into atmosphere.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Marlon Fenn appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a boss during the "Trial and Error" Uprising.
